name: oona
experimental: people stage (#5): the prop route, experimental until its gates pass on every look
approved: owner, 2026-10-11 (#5, #6): people are made like every prop (Pixal3D shape, split into parts, SOMA-X only for the skeleton so Kimodo's clips play); world 1 finished today
why: Oona sitting still in her suit beside Bram at the camp
description: an Irish woman in her thirties, an astronaut of the first expedition, a medium build, shoulder-length curly red hair, freckles

outfit_words.space: a white one-piece space suit: a round white helmet open at the front so the face shows, its gold visor pushed up over the top, a light grey neck ring, a slim grey control box on the chest with a small screen and dark knobs and two grey hoses down to the hips, a big boxy white backpack, light grey harness straps and belt, pairs of blue stripes round the upper arms and the lower legs, a US flag patch on the left upper arm, white thigh pockets, white gloves, chunky white moon boots
